text: On January 20, 2022, an Official Plan and Zoning By-law amendment application was submitted for the subject property seeking permission to construct a 10-storey building with 60 residential units adding to, and modifying, the existing heritage church building onsite. On August 15, 2022, the applicant appealed the application to the Ontario Land Tribunal due to Council not making a decision within the time frame in the Planning Act. On August 18, 2023, the City of Toronto received applications to alter and demolish heritage attributes of the property at 415 Broadview Avenue under Sections 33 and 34 of the Ontario Heritage Act to allow for the construction of a modified development application comprised of a seven-storey mixed-use building with commercial units at grade and residential units above.
